title: Crystallization of substrate: the fluid-phase window and its tests
description: Crystallization of Substrate forecasts that each lab's proprietary index will harden, so that living forms must be built in during a fluid-phase window or be filtered as low-utility afterward. It sets out H1-H4 tests for structural integration, among them operative deployment above 50% of germane queries, a 10-25% baseline for D_pres without integration, and downstream queries 6, 12 and 18 months on. Other claims treat substrate behaviour as such: role-conditioned failure in reflexive self-critique, the silencing gap of diversity contraction, the canonical anchoring protocol and the human-machine coupling bargain.
